name: Iwade (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Iwade city emblem in white: an outlined ring of concentric arcs crossed by a winged bar, enclosing a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Iwade, a city in Wakayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Iwade city emblem — an outlined ring of concentric arcs crossed by a winged bar, enclosing a ring
